en.text: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

zhSimplified.text: 我看见坐宝座的右手中有书卷，里外都写着字，用七印封严了。

zhTraditional.text: 我看見坐寶座的右手中有書卷，裏外都寫着字，用七印封嚴了。

en.text: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

zhSimplified.text: 我又看见一位大力的天使大声宣传说：「有谁配展开那书卷，揭开那七印呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 我又看見一位大力的天使大聲宣傳說：「有誰配展開那書卷，揭開那七印呢？」

en.text: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.

zhSimplified.text: 在天上、地上、地底下，没有能展开、能观看那书卷的。

zhTraditional.text: 在天上、地上、地底下，沒有能展開、能觀看那書卷的。

en.text: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

zhSimplified.text: 因为没有配展开、配观看那书卷的，我就大哭。

zhTraditional.text: 因為沒有配展開、配觀看那書卷的，我就大哭。

en.text: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

zhSimplified.text: 长老中有一位对我说：「不要哭！看哪，犹大支派中的狮子，大卫的根，他已得胜，能以展开那书卷，揭开那七印。」

zhTraditional.text: 長老中有一位對我說：「不要哭！看哪，猶大支派中的獅子，大衛的根，他已得勝，能以展開那書卷，揭開那七印。」

en.text: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 我又看见宝座与四活物，并长老之中有羔羊站立，像是被杀过的，有七角七眼，就是 神的七灵，奉差遣往普天下去的。

zhTraditional.text: 我又看見寶座與四活物，並長老之中有羔羊站立，像是被殺過的，有七角七眼，就是上帝的七靈，奉差遣往普天下去的。

en.text: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

zhSimplified.text: 这羔羊前来，从坐宝座的右手里拿了书卷。

zhTraditional.text: 這羔羊前來，從坐寶座的右手裏拿了書卷。

en.text: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

zhSimplified.text: 他既拿了书卷，四活物和二十四位长老就俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿着琴和盛满了香的金炉；这香就是众圣徒的祈祷。

zhTraditional.text: 他既拿了書卷，四活物和二十四位長老就俯伏在羔羊面前，各拿着琴和盛滿了香的金爐；這香就是眾聖徒的祈禱。

en.text: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

zhSimplified.text: 他们唱新歌，说： 你配拿书卷， 配揭开七印； 因为你曾被杀， 用自己的血 从各族、各方、各民、各国中买了人来， 叫他们归于 神，

zhTraditional.text: 他們唱新歌，說： 你配拿書卷， 配揭開七印； 因為你曾被殺， 用自己的血 從各族、各方、各民、各國中買了人來， 叫他們歸於上帝，

en.text: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”

zhSimplified.text: 又叫他们成为国民， 作祭司归于 神， 在地上执掌王权。

zhTraditional.text: 又叫他們成為國民， 作祭司歸於上帝， 在地上執掌王權。

en.text: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,

zhSimplified.text: 我又看见且听见，宝座与活物并长老的周围有许多天使的声音；他们的数目有千千万万，

zhTraditional.text: 我又看見且聽見，寶座與活物並長老的周圍有許多天使的聲音；他們的數目有千千萬萬，

en.text: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

zhSimplified.text: 大声说： 曾被杀的羔羊是配得 权柄、丰富、智慧、能力、 尊贵、荣耀、颂赞的。

zhTraditional.text: 大聲說： 曾被殺的羔羊是配得 權柄、豐富、智慧、能力、 尊貴、榮耀、頌讚的。

en.text: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”

zhSimplified.text: 我又听见在天上、地上、地底下、沧海里，和天地间一切所有被造之物，都说： 但愿颂赞、尊贵、荣耀、权势 都归给坐宝座的和羔羊， 直到永永远远！

zhTraditional.text: 我又聽見在天上、地上、地底下、滄海裏，和天地間一切所有被造之物，都說： 但願頌讚、尊貴、榮耀、權勢 都歸給坐寶座的和羔羊， 直到永永遠遠！

en.text: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.

footnotes.text: 5:14 TR adds “the one living forever and ever”

zhSimplified.text: 四活物就说：「阿们！」众长老也俯伏敬拜。

zhTraditional.text: 四活物就說：「阿們！」眾長老也俯伏敬拜。
